description:
## Objective

Make all imported offline surfaces persistent repository backpressure.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U20`
Covers: `R2 through R10 and R17 through R22; KTD3, KTD5, KTD8, KTD11, KTD14 through KTD17.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.9 (U9) — Port Action compilation examples must be complete; jido-07x.10 (U10) — Port Action execution examples must be complete; jido-07x.11 (U11) — Port advanced Action examples must be complete; jido-07x.12 (U12) — Port core basic and workflow examples must be complete; jido-07x.14 (U14) — Port core Plugin and persistence examples must be complete; jido-07x.17 (U17) — Port opt-in external service checks must be complete; jido-07x.18 (U18) — Reconcile offline AI benchmarks must be complete; jido-07x.19 (U19) — Port the AI live provider check must be complete; jido-07x.24 (U24) — Generate and enforce the quality report must be complete.
- Unblocks: None.

## Files

Add `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Change `mix.exs`, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, and `test/quality/README.md`. Do not change `lib/**`.

## Instructions

1. Add named required offline jobs for formatting, warnings, unit tests, Covenant, Reach, authoring, examples, bounded properties, local system, load, and benchmark smoke.
2. Add scheduled or manual extended fuzz, burn-in, and benchmark jobs.
3. Keep service and live jobs manual.
4. Add a change-to-command matrix to `AGENTS.md`.
5. Make README commands match Mix aliases.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each required offline surface has a named CI job.
- [ ] CI runs Covenant and Reach.
- [ ] Live and service checks are not required offline jobs.
- [ ] Agent guidance names the focused command for each change type.

## Verification

- `mix test.ci`, `mix quality`, `mix quality.report`, `mix covenant.check`, and `mix reach.check --arch --smells` exit with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.

comments.text: Completed in 0450e92 on main. Added .github/workflows/ci.yml, the CI workflow contract test, test.all, fresh-process test.ci execution, fixed seed 0, contributor command guidance, a line-specific Dialyzer baseline with unused-filter enforcement, a 17-clone ExDNA brownfield ceiling, and an explicit Credo blocking/advisory policy. Resolved covenant-persistence-token-cleanup-race by moving the token test Agent under ExUnit supervision. No source-manifest record changed. Verification passed: mix test.all; mix quality; mix quality.contract; 250 repeated token-suite runs (1,000 tests); fixed-seed full Covenant 3,334 passed/457 excluded and 323/323 obligations; clean mix quality.coverage at 93.1783% across 40 components and ten suite contributions; clean mix quality.report with all ten suites passing, zero open findings, and zero waivers; workflow tests, compile warnings, formatting, and diff checks. Live provider success was not run without an approved key; service live-host limits remain documented. No lib/** or refs/** change. Deviation: static debt uses explicit no-new-debt baselines because the plan forbids existing lib cleanup. Remaining blocker: none for U20.
